predicted_relation: With geometry, materials, cameras, and all non-target environments fixed, changing lighting or emissive intensity in scene partition P0 must not change RGB output of render products bound to disjoint partitions beyond each untouched environment's frozen no-edit noise envelope.
predicted_mechanism: OVRTX temporal reconstruction or denoising state is shared or keyed above the per-render-product / per-scene-partition scope, so an env-0 lighting update contaminates reconstruction history used by untouched environments even though the USD light-intensity state itself remains partition-correct.
owner_boundary: OVRTX render-product temporal reconstruction / denoiser state partitioning, downstream of IsaacLab/USD scene authoring and partition tags but upstream of final RGB output.
discriminating_experiment: In fresh processes with the same explicit scene partitions, repeat the env-0-only light/emission toggle while disabling temporal reconstruction/denoising or forcing per-frame history reset. Keep geometry, camera, materials, partition tags, and USD intensity readbacks fixed. Test analytic lights and emissive mesh separately. The prediction is supported if untouched-env leakage collapses to the no-edit noise bound specifically when temporal history is disabled/reset.
falsifier: The prediction is falsified if cross-environment leakage remains at the same magnitude after temporal reconstruction/denoising is disabled and history is cleared, or if the supposedly untouched environments show corresponding USD/light-state changes, or if the same leakage appears under Isaac RTX with the same partition tags and settling protocol.
repair_boundary: Partition or reset OVRTX temporal/denoiser accumulation state per render product / scene partition; do not compensate output pixels, alter policy observations, or globally reset all renderer state as the semantic repair.
